nodes.label: 1.1_QualityControl.qmd
nodes.rationale: Quality-control notebook comparing human and mouse blood transcriptomic responses across multiple pathogens, assessing normalization (raw vs quantile), distribution, correlation and PCA.

nodes.label: my_dens
nodes.rationale: Custom ggplot density panel function used as the diagonal of ggpairs correlation panels.

nodes.label: my_point
nodes.rationale: Custom ggplot scatter panel function used as the lower triangle of ggpairs correlation panels.

nodes.label: theme_vaxgo
nodes.rationale: Shared project ggplot theme applied to every figure for visual consistency.

nodes.label: colors palette object
nodes.rationale: Central colour palette (organism, timepoint, comparison) reused across plots.

nodes.label: human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc
nodes.rationale: Per-sample log2 fold change data for raw and quantile-normalized influenza values, the base table for distribution and correlation analysis.

nodes.label: human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_log2fc_avg
nodes.rationale: Gene-level averaged log2FC/effect-size table used for volcano and cross-species correlation plots.

nodes.label: human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn
nodes.rationale: Raw and quantile-normalized expression values, used as input for expression PCA.

nodes.label: human_mouse_fluad_raw_qn_avg
nodes.rationale: Averaged expression values used for averaged distribution violin boxes.

nodes.label: all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc
nodes.rationale: Pan-pathogen log2FC sample table imported for Hepatitis B, Influenza, S. aureus, E. coli, Burn and Trauma analyses.

nodes.label: human_mouse_metadata
nodes.rationale: Sample metadata (participant, organism, timepoint, sex, age) joined to expression tables.

nodes.label: all_degs_human_mouse
nodes.rationale: Limma differential expression results used to derive the human DEG gene set.

nodes.label: all_human_mouse_samples_log2fc_annotated
nodes.rationale: Log2FC table joined with metadata so each sample carries organism/timepoint/participant annotations.

nodes.label: long_expr
nodes.rationale: Per-pathogen filtered annotated expression table (long format).

nodes.label: long_expr_log2fc_avg
nodes.rationale: Gene-level summary aggregating mean/sd/se of expression, log2FC and effect size within each organism and timepoint.

nodes.label: annotation_samples_pca
nodes.rationale: Sample-to-metadata lookup used to colour PCA points.

nodes.label: human_degs
nodes.rationale: Human differentially expressed gene symbol vector used to restrict PCA and correlation inputs.

nodes.label: clean_matrix_raw
nodes.rationale: Sample-by-gene matrix of raw values with non-finite entries set to 0 before PCA.

nodes.label: clean_matrix_qn
nodes.rationale: Sample-by-gene matrix of quantile-normalized values prepared for PCA to compare against raw.

nodes.label: clean_matrix_log2fc
nodes.rationale: Sample-by-gene log2FC matrix used for PCA on fold-change rather than expression.

nodes.label: pca_raw
nodes.rationale: PCA of raw expression/log2FC values (outer product) used to expose outlier samples.

nodes.label: pca_qn
nodes.rationale: PCA of quantile-normalized values, compared against raw PCA to judge normalization benefit.

nodes.label: pca_log2fc
nodes.rationale: PCA plot on log2FC matrix (per-pathogen) to visualise sample clustering.

nodes.label: pca_expression
nodes.rationale: PCA plot on expression matrix paired with log2FC PCA.

nodes.label: pca_log2fc_expression
nodes.rationale: Patchwork combining expression and log2FC PCA panels for each pathogen.

nodes.label: volcano_data
nodes.rationale: Volcano plot data derived from averaged log2FC with -log10 adjusted p-value and Up/Down/NS significance labels (threshold logp > 2).

nodes.label: volcano_plot_raw_qn
nodes.rationale: Faceted volcano figure (Day x organism x measure) summarising differential expression.

nodes.label: rle_plot
nodes.rationale: Relative Log Expression boxplot per sample detecting sample-level outliers.

nodes.label: sa_plot
nodes.rationale: SA plot of mean expression vs standard deviation to examine mean-variance relationship.

nodes.label: ma_plot
nodes.rationale: MA plot of mean expression vs log2FC to detect intensity-dependent fold-change bias.

nodes.label: distribution_check_subject_plot
nodes.rationale: Kaboxplot overlaying per-subject IQR boxes with quantile lines to compare subject distributions.

nodes.label: distribution_check_log2fc_plot
nodes.rationale: Density plot of log2FC by organism and timepoint, overlaid by organism.

nodes.label: distribution_check_avg_plot
nodes.rationale: Density plot of averaged expression by organism and timepoint.

nodes.label: correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary
nodes.rationale: Combine Human-vs-Mouse, Human-vs-Human and Mouse-vs-Mouse correlation summaries for shared timepoints.

nodes.label: correlation_long_all_mouse_human_timepoints_summary_plot
nodes.rationale: Line plot of mean Pearson correlation over time with 95% CI error bars for each comparison type.

nodes.label: cor_human_mouse_timepoint
nodes.rationale: Human vs Mouse Pearson correlations computed for each matched timepoint pair across all participant pairs.

nodes.label: cor_human_human
nodes.rationale: Within-human participant pairwise correlations per timepoint.

nodes.label: cor_mouse_mouse
nodes.rationale: Within-mouse participant pairwise correlations per timepoint.

nodes.label: scatter_plot_data
nodes.rationale: Wide-format per-participant log2FC matrix feeding ggpairs correlation scatterplots.

nodes.label: mouse_correlation_ggpairs_alldays
nodes.rationale: GGally ggpairs matrix of pairwise mouse-mouse correlations across all timepoints.

nodes.label: human_correlation_ggpairs_alldays
nodes.rationale: GGally ggpairs matrix of pairwise human-human correlations across all timepoints.

nodes.label: distribution_check_subject_raw_qn_log2fc_all
nodes.rationale: Composite 2x2 patch of subject and averaged expression/log2FC distributions.

nodes.label: prcomp
nodes.rationale: Base R principal component analysis used to project samples on PC1/PC2.

nodes.label: cor.test
nodes.rationale: Base R Pearson correlation test with confidence intervals used for cross-species comparisons.

nodes.label: long_expr_log2fc_avg
nodes.rationale: Average and dispersion statistics are aggregated per gene x pathogen x organism x timepoint to summarise mean-variance and log2FC relationships for QC.

nodes.label: outliers
nodes.rationale: Samples with PC1 > 100 are flagged as outliers in the PCA of log2FC and saved for downstream exclusion.

hyperedges.label: Cross-species correlation analysis (Human vs Mouse, Human vs Human, Mouse vs Mouse)
Pathogen cohorts analysed with shared QC workflow
